figurative_meaning_en: To become stunned or bewildered due to fear and anxiety
example_sentences_in_bangla: খবরটা শুনে তার মুণ্ড ঘুরে গেল।
পরীক্ষার ফলাফল দেখে ছাত্রটির মুণ্ড ঘুরে যাবার উপক্রম হলো।
example_sentences_in_english: Upon hearing the news, his head spun.
Seeing the exam results, the student was on the verge of his head spinning in shock.
history: This idiom originates from traditional Bengali marriage negotiations, where the groom's family lists excessive demands (দাবী), causing the bride's family to feel overwhelmed and stunned, as if their heads are spinning.
note: The idiom reflects cultural practices in rural or semi-rural Bengali wedding traditions.
